property_summary: When a user calls collectDrugs with a referral address, the reference sets the referral if the user has none, while the bug never sets it because the condition checks that the user already has a non-zero referral.
change_summary: Replace the condition `referrals[msg.sender] == address(0)` with `referrals[msg.sender] != address(0)`, so the referral is set only if the user already has a referral, which is impossible if they start with none, thus never setting referrals.
